fields.title: Tiny Green Mushroom

fields.text: A small bag in 34 CACHE contains 3 doses of toad shavings; Appendix D is referenced.
fields.title: Toad Shavings

fields.text: A 30' rope is hung on the west wall of 31 TRAVERSE and tied to an iron spike at each end. Using it lets a character cross the pit without a roll.
fields.title: 30' Traverse Rope and Iron Spikes

fields.text: A comb made from a whelk, worth 100s, is with the mummy in 26 SECRET CRYPT.
fields.title: Whelk Comb

fields.text: Captain Conroy remained with the ghouls for their first year, then became the fungal remains in 33 FUNGUS. Disgusted by ghoul hunger, he prayed to Shendormu and received this release. His last order was that his soldiers destroy themselves; some obeyed, and those who did not became the surviving ghouls.
fields.title: Captain Conroy's Fate and Last Order

fields.text: The ghouls first ask for human meat, lots of meat, destruction of the ghost fence in 40 GHOST FENCE, and humiliation of the spider crab in 31 TRAVERSE. If at least 3 are achieved, they also ask the party to beat Gerdith at a miniatures wargame in 28 GAMES, outperform Jasper at a show in 29 STAGE, and destroy the Lamb with cautious ghoul assistance. Each killed ghoul deducts one favor. At 4 favors they try very hard not to eat the party, requiring a Cha save to resist. At 5 favors the party's favorite ghoul joins. At 6 favors they reveal the door behind Captain Conroy in 33 FUNGUS and discuss their trauma. At 7 favors Gerdith gives her crysmere blade and they reveal Shawson's prison and magic item, though they will not help kill him.
fields.title: Ghoul Favors and Rewards

fields.text: Five ghouls are trapped between 21 HEAVY DOOR and 40 GHOST FENCE. Jasper and Luntz wander the halls playing at being gentlemen; Gerdith and Molina guard the ballista; Shawson is feral and imprisoned in 39 STONE EGG; Captain Conroy is absent after ascending to moldhood. The surviving ghouls were soldiers. Hunger can overwhelm them, but after consuming a large amount of meat they become lucid, conversant, compassionate, and remorseful. Fresh meat, respectful treatment, and military-style parlay can be used to befriend any of them except Shawson.
fields.title: The Ghouls of the Second Floor

contents: A 10' heavy bar.
A set of chains.
fields.first_impression: A pair of heavy iron doors is held closed by a 10' heavy bar and chains; chatter and laughter are audible from Jasper and Luntz on the far side.
hidden: Removing the bar grants a Milestone only if the Lamb has not already been killed.
Jasper and Luntz intend to feign friendship and eat the party when they get an opportunity.
occupants: Jasper and Luntz are on the far side when the doors are first approached.
fields.title: 21 HEAVY DOORS
triggers: Fumbling with the doors causes Jasper and Luntz to attempt an unconvincing friendly deception.
If the party leaves and returns later, Jasper and Luntz instead wander the halls and may appear as random encounters.

contents: A locked door to the north.
A defaced south door bearing the words “ASSHOLE STORAGE”.
A huge cobweb partly blocking the path east to 24 CRUSH HALLWAY.
A tiny green mushroom growing in exposed dirt.

discoverable.condition: Dig 10' beneath the mushroom.
discoverable.information: A dagger, a sling, and an empty wineskin are buried beneath the mushroom.

discoverable.condition: Reach 3' into a wall hole and continually depress its switch.
discoverable.information: Each of three wall holes contains a switch 3' deep that disarms one trap door in 24 CRUSH HALLWAY while continuously depressed.

fields.first_impression: A locked door stands to the north; the south door is carved with “ASSHOLE STORAGE”; a huge cobweb partly blocks the east route; a tiny green mushroom grows in exposed dirt in the southwest corner.
hidden: Eating the mushroom makes the eater Favored by Shendormu.
resources: A buried dagger, sling, and empty wineskin.
fields.title: 22 MUSHROOM

contents: A mummified head with its eyes and mouth sewn shut.
A shiny object held in the head's teeth.

discoverable.condition: Inspect and retrieve the objects from the mummified head's teeth.
discoverable.information: The shiny objects are 10g coins and a note reading “now we're paid up, rat fuck”.

fields.first_impression: The brick floor sags about 2' at the center, water drips from the ceiling, and a mummified head with sewn eyes and mouth lies exactly in the middle with something shiny in its teeth.
hazards: The weak brick floor can collapse completely under 40 lbs once more than 10' from the south door.
hidden: Small thrown objects cause localized collapses.
More than 10' from the south door, 40 lbs is enough to collapse every remaining brick floor tile.
The far door is practically impossible to smash from an unstable climbing position unless first weakened by acid or fire; a ballista bolt opens it instantly.
fields.title: 23 WEAK FLOOR

contents: Crushed furniture debris on the east side.

discoverable.condition: Tap the floor to listen for hollow sections.
discoverable.information: Three perfectly disguised trap doors sound hollow.

fields.first_impression: A 90' hallway has thick splinters and wood shards spread around its east side.
hazards: The ceiling falls 10' in 10 seconds, rests for 10 seconds, then resets.
Three disguised spring trap doors drop victims 40' to water below.
hidden: Any contact heavier than a feather triggers the descending ceiling.
Each disguised trap door is driven by a hinge and strong spring.
fields.title: 24 CRUSH HALLWAY
triggers: Entering the hallway or applying more than feather-light contact starts the ceiling's lowering cycle.

contents: Water, 10' deep.
A floating broken chair missing two legs.

fields.title: 24A

contents: Water, 10' deep.
A rusted-shut portcullis permitting sight but not access into 42 SUNKEN GALLERY.

contents: Water, 10' deep.
A surface layer of oil.

discoverable.information: Two flasks of oil and broken glass lie on the bottom.

Tiled patterns covering the walls from floor to ceiling.
fields.first_impression: Each crypt contains a central stone sarcophagus and tiled wall patterns; heavy bootsteps and humming can be heard from 27 BALLISTA.
hidden: A light source entering 25E, 25F, or 25G is noticed by the ghouls in 27 BALLISTA.
Reassembling and returning all seven mummies, or close enough, makes the character who took the most initiative Favored by Vandoh.
The missing heads required to reassemble the mummies are in 29 STAGE.

triggers: Combat, use of a portcullis winch, a dropped sarcophagus lid, or visible light can alert Gerdith.

contents: A third quarter moon motif.
A central stone sarcophagus.

discoverable.condition: Open the stone sarcophagus.
discoverable.information: The sarcophagus contains 7 mummified left arms.

discoverable.condition: Remove or investigate the tiles on the south wall.
discoverable.information: The door to 26 SECRET CRYPT is behind the south-wall tiles.

fields.first_impression: A third-quarter-moon motif marks this crypt, where a stone sarcophagus rests in the center.
hidden: A door to 26 SECRET CRYPT is concealed behind the south-wall tiles.

contents: A waning gibbous moon motif.
A central stone sarcophagus.
A lowered portcullis to the south.
A winch 10' south of the portcullis.

discoverable.condition: Open the stone sarcophagus.
discoverable.information: The sarcophagus contains 7 mummified right arms, one with a hook-hand prosthesis.

fields.first_impression: A waning-gibbous-moon motif marks this crypt; a stone sarcophagus rests in the center and the portcullis to the south is lowered.

contents: A first quarter moon motif.
A central stone sarcophagus.

A central stone sarcophagus.

A central stone sarcophagus.

contents: A waxing crescent moon motif.

fields.first_impression: A new-moon motif marks this crypt, where a stone sarcophagus rests in the center.

A soldier's corpse in the western passage.

fields.first_impression: Huge blue polypores cover the south wall; a complex chromatic fungal mass covers the north wall around a chair, visible legs, and a barely discernible skull; a harpoon and six silver shilavos stand along the east side.
hazards: While the blue polypores remain intact, no violence is possible in the room; a damaged character gets a Cha Save to resist.
hidden: The blue polypores emit an aura that prevents violence while intact.
The fungal remains are Captain Conroy, transformed after praying to Shendormu.
Captain Conroy's last order was that his soldiers destroy themselves.
fields.title: 33 FUNGUS

contents: A set of plate mail with conidiaspore insignia.
A shield bearing a red mushroom rampant.
A red silk battle standard of the house of the avenging angel, worth 200s.
A magnificent steel pipe worth 50s.
A small bag with 2 doses of purple lotus powder.
A small bag with 3 doses of toad shavings.
Two blowtubes of mevverwen.
fields.first_impression: A concealed cache holds armor, a shield, a red battle standard, a steel pipe, and bags and blowtubes of unusual substances.
hidden: Returning the battle standard to the Garrison of the Green Angel earns an invitation to join them as a knight.
fields.title: 34 CACHE

contents: A 4'-deep round hole in the ceiling.
A chalk limerick ending with Clyde having “dyed”.

discoverable.condition: Reach 4' into the ceiling hole and depress the switch.
discoverable.information: A switch at the back of the ceiling hole opens a trap door in the hallway's exact center.

discoverable.condition: Fall or descend to the water-level furniture pile and search the stacked furniture.
discoverable.information: A rotten credenza drawer in the pit contains 50s and a hooked net.

fields.first_impression: A small round hole, 4' deep, is centered in the ceiling; a chalk limerick about Clyde's drab clothes is written on the wall.
hazards: A switch-controlled central trap door drops victims 40'.
hidden: The trap door drops victims 40' onto stacked furniture barely above the water.
The bottom of the pit connects with 42 SUNKEN GALLERY.
fields.title: 35 TRICKY HALLWAY

contents: A banquet table and five chairs.
A silver platter worth 50s.
A candelabra worth 20s.
A tiny green mushroom growing from a plate.
fields.first_impression: A banquet table with five chairs holds a silver platter, a candelabra, and a tiny green mushroom growing from one plate.
fields.title: 36 TABLE

contents: Gnawed bones amounting to about 2 dozen human skeletons if reassembled.
Several spider-crab shell and claw fragments, none as large as the specimen in 43 SPIDER CRAB.
A burlap sack of more gnawed bones.
A tattered red banner on the north wall, supported by two broken chair legs inserted into wall holes.

discoverable.condition: Search the bone rubbish.
discoverable.information: A spear with a shrunken head tied to it by the hair lies in the rubbish.

discoverable.condition: Remove both chair legs and inspect the holes.
discoverable.information: Each chair-leg hole is 4' deep and contains a switch; both must be pressed together to toggle the secret door.

discoverable.condition: Stand on a chair in the middle of the room while holding a torch.
discoverable.information: Shawson's yellow eyes are visible before he growls and retreats.

fields.first_impression: A mountain of gnawed bones fills the room, with a sack of more bones, a tattered red banner on the north wall, and two broken chair legs fixed through it into the wall.
hazards: Shawson waits to surprise, grab, and drag the first climber into 39 STONE EGG.
hidden: The closest person feels their teeth chattering from the heads in 40 GHOST FENCE as soon as the room is entered.
The remote effect extends into 38 SHROUD as far as the heads can see.
The secret door is a 2' by 2' north-wall panel 8' above the ground.
Shawson hears the door open and waits beside the opening to ambush the first climber.
resources: A spear with a shrunken head.
fields.title: 37 CHEWED BONES
triggers: Entering the room causes the closest person to feel the ghost-fence heads' effect.
Pressing both hidden switches simultaneously opens the secret door; pressing both again closes it.
Opening the secret door prepares Shawson's ambush.

steps: A human can sprint across before the ceiling crushes without a Movement check, but Movement checks are required to jump the three disguised trap doors unless those doors are disabled.
Alternatively, throw an uncrushable object such as the metal cage, ballista, or a combination of sturdy objects into the hallway; those objects are not recoverable.
Alternatively, climb along the wall with iron spikes and ropes; this takes about an hour and causes a couple of encounter checks.
Alternatively, disable the trap doors from 22 MUSHROOM and then sprint across.
fields.title: Cross 24 CRUSH HALLWAY
fields.trigger: The party attempts to traverse the 90' crushing hallway.

steps: Reach 3' into a wall hole to find its switch.
Continually depress the switch to disarm the corresponding trap door in 24 CRUSH HALLWAY.
Repeat with the other two holes to hold all three trap doors disabled.
fields.title: Disarm the Trap Doors in 24 CRUSH HALLWAY
fields.trigger: A character uses the three wall holes in 22 MUSHROOM.

steps: Gerdith loudly orders Molina to accompany her.
Molina complains and cracks jokes.
Both armored ghouls move to investigate intelligently and ravenously.
fields.title: Gerdith's Investigation
fields.trigger: Gerdith is alerted by noise, a winch, a dropped sarcophagus lid, combat, or visible light.

steps: One person can move a lid with a successful Str check.
Six people can gently set the lid on the floor or pick it up.
fields.title: Move a Crypt Sarcophagus Lid
fields.trigger: The party attempts to open or move a stone sarcophagus lid in 25 CRYPT.

steps: Two people can pry the 10' bar aside, opening the doors just enough for a human to squeeze through; the Lamb cannot fit.
The chains cannot be removed without heavy tools.
Removing the chains allows the doors to open fully.
fields.title: Open 21 HEAVY DOORS
fields.trigger: The party attempts to pass the barred and chained heavy iron doors.

steps: Reach to the back of the hole.
Operate the switch there to open the secret door marked by the worn floor near the east wall.
fields.title: Open the Secret Door in 32 ISOPODS
fields.trigger: A character investigates the 5'-deep round hole in the north wall.

steps: Collect the distributed arms, legs, torsos, and heads belonging to seven mummies.
Reassemble all seven mummies, or come close enough to a full reconstruction.
Return the reassembled mummies.
Identify the character who took the most initiative; that character becomes Favored by Vandoh.
fields.title: Reassemble and Return the Seven Mummies
fields.trigger: The party gathers the scattered mummy parts and missing heads from the crypts and 29 STAGE.

steps: Reach 4' into each of the two holes to find a switch.
Press both switches simultaneously to open the 2' by 2' panel 8' above the floor.
Press both switches simultaneously again to close the door.
fields.title: Toggle the Secret Door in 37 CHEWED BONES
fields.trigger: The party removes the two broken chair legs from the north-wall holes.

activation.condition: The party enters 32 ISOPODS.

actor_reactions.reaction: Ignore the party if left alone, curl if poked, and fight back if damaged.

outcomes: Unprovoked isopods continue foraging and ignore the party.
Poked isopods curl into balls.
Damaged isopods fight back.

participants.role: Forage, curl defensively, and retaliate only if harmed.

fields.perceived: Three armored isopods forage calmly and ignore the party.
stakes: Provoking the isopods can trigger a fight against creatures protected by Defense Curl.
fields.title: Three Armored Isopods Foraging

activation.condition: Combat, a portcullis winch, a dropped sarcophagus lid, or visible light in 25E, 25F, 25G, or 29 STAGE alerts Gerdith.

actor_reactions.reaction: Loudly orders Molina to accompany her and investigates.
Complains, cracks jokes, and accompanies Gerdith.

outcomes: Gerdith and Molina investigate together.

participants.role: Detects the disturbance, commands the response, and leads the investigation.
Accompanies Gerdith while complaining and joking.

fields.perceived: Heavy bootsteps and humming are audible from 27 BALLISTA; after an alert, Gerdith loudly orders Molina to accompany her and the two armored ghouls move to investigate.

possible_effects.description: The disturbance alerts Gerdith.
Gerdith initiates an investigation with Molina.

stakes: Exploration of the crypts and stage can draw two intelligent, ravenous armored ghouls.
fields.title: Gerdith and Molina Investigate an Alert

activation.condition: Any touch greater than a feather in the hallway triggers the ceiling; stepping on a trap door triggers that floor panel.

outcomes: A human can sprint the length without a Movement check for the ceiling.
Movement checks are needed to jump the three trap doors unless disabled.
The ceiling takes 10 seconds to fall 10', rests for 10 seconds, then resets.
fields.perceived: After someone enters the 90' hall, the ceiling begins descending toward the floor; hidden floor panels can spring open beneath runners.

repeat.condition: The ceiling falls, rests, and resets; trap doors remain active unless their remote switches are held.

stakes: Entrants can be crushed by the ceiling.
Runners can fall 40' through one of three disguised trap doors into the water chambers.
fields.title: 24 CRUSH HALLWAY Trap

activation.condition: The party enters 37 CHEWED BONES; the closest person to the heads is affected.

fields.perceived: On entering, the person closest to the heads in 40 GHOST FENCE feels their teeth chattering.
stakes: A remote effect from 40 GHOST FENCE reaches through 37 CHEWED BONES and into 38 SHROUD as far as the heads can see.
fields.title: Ghost Fence Effect Reaches 37 CHEWED BONES

activation.condition: 40 GHOST FENCE is destroyed.

completion: The surviving ghouls depart after their final preparations, no later than the applicable 12- or 24-hour window.
outcomes: The ghouls leave the dungeon within 12 hours.
If the party promises to return and help kill the Lamb, they may remain for as long as 24 hours.
The party may encounter them later as NPCs.

participants.role: One of the surviving ghouls who may depart.
One of the surviving ghouls who may depart.
One of the surviving ghouls who may depart.
One of the surviving ghouls who may depart.

fields.perceived: After the ghost fence is destroyed, the surviving ghouls prepare to collect belongings, revisit their home, and say farewell to Captain Conroy before leaving.

possible_effects.description: The party may meet the departed ghouls again as NPCs.

fields.title: Ghouls Leave After the Ghost Fence Falls

activation.condition: The party treats the non-feral ghouls respectfully, supplies enough fresh meat for lucidity, or begins military-style parlay.

outcomes: At 4 favors, the ghouls make a strong effort not to eat the party, with a Cha save to resist.
At 5 favors, the party's favorite ghoul joins the party.
At 6 favors, the ghouls reveal the door behind Captain Conroy in 33 FUNGUS and discuss their trauma.
At 7 favors, Gerdith gives the crysmere blade and the ghouls reveal Shawson's prison and magic item.
The ghouls may help kill the Lamb but will not take risks.
They will not help kill Shawson, though they do not condemn the party for doing so.

participants.role: Requests meat and can judge a stage performance.
Participates in the ghoul bargain.
Can be challenged at the miniature wargame and gives the crysmere blade at seven favors.
Participates in the ghoul bargain.

fields.perceived: Lucid ghouls bargain for meat, escape, humiliation of a rival creature, games, a performance, and the Lamb's destruction, treating the party better as more favors are completed.

possible_effects.description: The favor ladder and later secrets become available through successful bargaining.
At five favors, the party's favorite non-feral ghoul may join the party.
The ghouls may assist against the Lamb without taking risks.

repeat.condition: The party can complete additional favors and improve its standing; each ghoul killed reduces the total by one.

stakes: The party may be eaten while the ghouls remain hungry.
The party can gain information, a companion, the crysmere blade, and cautious help against the Lamb.
fields.title: Negotiating Favors with the Ghouls

activation.condition: The party approaches or fumbles with 21 HEAVY DOORS.

actor_reactions.reaction: Pretends friendship while looking for an opportunity to eat the party.
Pretends friendship while looking for an opportunity to eat the party.

approaches: Pry the bar and squeeze through.
Use heavy tools to remove the chains.
Offer the ghouls dead bodies elsewhere.
outcomes: If offered bodies elsewhere, the ghouls pretend to agree, circle back, and attack shortly afterward.
If the party leaves, the pair later wander the halls and can appear as random encounters.

participants.role: Leads the theatrical, unconvincing friendly overture.
Supports the overture and shares the intent to eat the party.

fields.perceived: Chatter and laughter come from beyond the barred doors; Jasper addresses the door like a party host and the two ghouls openly complain of hunger while attempting friendliness.

possible_effects.description: Jasper and Luntz can become later wandering encounters if the party leaves.

repeat.condition: If the party leaves, Jasper and Luntz later move into the random-encounter rotation instead of resetting this scene.

stakes: The party risks a deceptive ghoul attack while trying to pass the doors.
fields.title: Jasper and Luntz at 21 HEAVY DOORS

activation.condition: The blue polypores on the south wall remain intact.

completion: The situation ends when the polypores are no longer intact.
outcomes: A character who takes any damage, even a pinprick or self-inflicted damage, receives a Cha Save to resist the aura.
fields.perceived: Attempts at violence in 33 FUNGUS are suppressed while the huge blue polypores remain intact.
stakes: No violence is possible in the room while the aura remains in force.
fields.title: Blue Polypore Aura of Nonviolence

activation.condition: The party decides to collect, reassemble, and return all seven mummies or a sufficiently close reconstruction.

completion: All seven mummies are reassembled and returned, or the reconstruction is close enough.
outcomes: The character who took the most initiative becomes Favored by Vandoh.
fields.perceived: Moon-marked crypts contain grouped mummy limbs and torsos, while five costumed heads appear on the stage and two more heads rest in a sack.

possible_effects.description: The most proactive character becomes Favored by Vandoh.

stakes: The scattered remains and missing heads must be matched and returned.
fields.title: Reassemble the Seven Mummies

activation.condition: Someone returns the standard from 34 CACHE to the Garrison of the Green Angel.

outcomes: The person returning it is invited to join the garrison as a knight.
fields.perceived: The red silk battle standard bears the identity of the house of the avenging angel.

possible_effects.description: The returning character is invited to become a knight of the Garrison of the Green Angel.

stakes: The standard can be exchanged for recognition by the Garrison of the Green Angel.
fields.title: Return the Avenging Angel Battle Standard

activation.condition: Both hidden switches open the secret door from 37 CHEWED BONES to 39 STONE EGG.

actor_reactions.reaction: Grabs and drags the first climber into 39 STONE EGG to eat them.
Growls and retreats if torchlight from a chair reveals his eyes.

outcomes: Shawson surprises and drags the first climber into 39 STONE EGG.
A torch-bearing observer on a central chair glimpses Shawson's yellow eyes and causes him to retreat.

participants.role: Waits beside the opening, surprises the first climber, and drags the victim into 39 STONE EGG.

fields.perceived: When the high secret panel opens, the first climber entering it is seized from the other side; torchlight can reveal a brief glimpse of yellow eyes before a growl.

repeat.condition: Shawson can wait again after retreating while the passage remains relevant.

stakes: The first climber can be isolated in 39 STONE EGG with a feral ghoul.
fields.title: Shawson Ambushes the Secret Opening

activation.condition: Characters approach or cross the pit in 31 TRAVERSE while the spider crab waits below.

actor_reactions.reaction: Retracts its eyestalks when it notices it has been observed.

participants.role: Watches from the water for an opportunity.

fields.perceived: Investigating the pit reveals eyestalks above the water; they retract as soon as the observer notices them.
stakes: The crab can reach 38' upward while the water is 40' below the floor.
fields.title: Spider Crab Watches the Traverse

activation.condition: The switch at the back of the 4'-deep ceiling hole is depressed.

outcomes: A victim lands on the furniture pile.
The pit connects to 42 SUNKEN GALLERY.
Searching the furniture can yield 50s and a hooked net.
fields.perceived: Depressing the hidden ceiling switch causes a trap door to open in the hallway's exact center.
stakes: Anyone on the trap door falls 40' onto stacked furniture above the water.
fields.title: 35 TRICKY HALLWAY Trap Door

activation.condition: Small objects cause local collapse; more than 10' from the south door, 40 lbs is enough to collapse the whole floor.

approaches: Test the floor with thrown objects.
Weaken the far door with acid or fire before attempting to break it.
Use a ballista bolt to open the far door instantly.
outcomes: Every remaining brick floor tile falls away after the threshold is exceeded.
The far door opens instantly if struck by a ballista bolt.
fields.perceived: The sagging brick floor gives way in small patches when light objects land on it and can suddenly collapse completely under greater weight.
stakes: Anyone on the brick floor may fall when the entire surface collapses.
The unstable footing prevents effective force against the far door.
fields.title: Collapse of 23 WEAK FLOOR

entries.result: 1d2 Lantern Worms. A single lantern worm, glossy like black rubber. You'll see its blinding searchlight long before you see the worm. 15' long.
Gnawing on bones (unless all ghouls dead).
Unique. Wetspot on the wall turns into a searchlight. If you do not avoid it, a lantern worm emerges.
Unique. In an adjacent room, Jasper and Luntz preparing an earthworm as if it were a feast.
Unique. In an adjacent room, Gerdith and Malenna discussing advantages between cavalry vs archers vs infantry.
A coiled up lantern worm. Looks like a huge, taught, black rubber hose. Quiescent until touched or light is brought near.

fields.appearance: A quadrupedal statue without a clear head or face, made of pinkish-brown stone and covered in whorls and grooves.
behavior: Begins attacking two rounds after someone enters the room.
Its gaze makes skin-covered, large-dice-sized cubes of a fleshy target fall away without pain, leaving healthy skin over the wounds and a sudden numb sensation.
capabilities: Lvl 4; Def none; Slam 1d6.
Amble slow; Climb spider; Int 3.
Stone — All non-bludgeoning damage is reduced to 1.
Ancient Tone — A fleshy target within 10 feet takes 1d6 damage; a Cha Save negates.
Anguish Pattern — Whenever this apparatus damages something with its tone, all ancient apparatuses within 30 feet, including itself, are healed for an equal amount.
Four feet of water above its head protects it from falling bricks.
goals: Attack people in the room.
Exit the pit and escape the room.
hidden: It is only a statue on the outside; it bleeds after losing half its hit points.

reactions.response: It begins bleeding, revealing that it is only a statue on the outside, and attempts to escape the room.
reactions.stimulus: The apparatus loses half of its hit points.

fields.role: A submerged ancient killing apparatus that activates after intruders enter, attacks them, and tries to escape the shrine pit.
fields.title: Ancient Apparatus of Anguish

behavior: Calls his intended victim his 'pretty little fish' and calls everyone else a 'dirty filthy'.
capabilities: Lvl 2; Def leather; Claw 1d6+agony.
Move as human; Int 5; Str 7; Dis hungry.
goals: Kill the person he currently calls his 'pretty little fish'.
fields.role: A ravenous, insane ghoul imprisoned in the Stone Egg room.
starting_state: Trying to kill his 'pretty little fish'.
fields.title: Shawson the Ghoul

fields.appearance: A giant undead spider crab that keeps its eyestalks above the murky water to watch the party.
behavior: Tries to keep its eyestalks above water while watching the party.
The first time it realizes it has been noticed, it tries to hide for a few seconds.
Eventually stands on any large object dropped in the pool and escapes.
capabilities: Lvl 7; Def leather; Claw/claw 1d8/1d8+grab.
Move slow; Int 5; Dis fanatical.
Can reach 38 feet out of the water.
Can squeeze through a 10-foot hallway.
goals: Watch the party from hiding.
Lunge at anything that drops within reach.
Escape the pit when given a large object to stand on.
hidden: It is all that remains of a high priestess of Vandoh.

reactions.response: It tries to hide for a few seconds.
reactions.stimulus: It first notices that the party has noticed it.

reactions.response: It lunges at the falling object or creature.
reactions.stimulus: Anything drops within its reach.

reactions.response: It eventually stands on the object and escapes the pit.
reactions.stimulus: A large object such as a table or ballista is dropped into the pool.

fields.role: A hidden pool predator and the remains of a high priestess of Vandoh; if it escapes, it becomes a wandering monster.
starting_state: Hiding in the water and watching the party with its eyestalks above the surface.
fields.title: Spider Crab

fields.text: All non-bludgeoning damage dealt to the ancient apparatus of anguish is reduced to 1.
fields.title: Stone

fields.text: A fleshy target within 10 feet takes 1d6 damage; a Cha Save negates. The apparatus's gaze makes parts of the target fall away as skin-covered cubes about the size of large dice. The resulting wounds are covered with healthy skin; there is no pain, only sudden numbness.
fields.title: Ancient Tone

fields.text: Whenever the apparatus damages something with its tone, every ancient apparatus within 30 feet, including this one, is healed for an amount equal to the damage dealt.
fields.title: Anguish Pattern

fields.text: If all ghouls are killed, the character whose left hand was possessed becomes Favored by Vandoh; the source points to Appendix D for the full effect.
fields.title: Favored by Vandoh

fields.text: While the heads are in formation, they stare at the nearest creature, living or undead, and chatter their teeth. The creature they stare at also chatters its teeth uncontrollably.
fields.title: Ghost Fence Chattering

fields.text: If the heads are touched or someone passes over them, the nearest living thing dies with no Save. Moving any head out of the specific formation ends the effect; returning the heads to formation restores it. The heads can be transported and set up elsewhere with the same effect.
fields.title: Ghost Fence Instant Death and Formation Dependence

fields.text: Shawson's claw attack is printed as 'Claw 1d6+agony'.
fields.title: Shawson's Agony

fields.text: When the winched guillotine falls on someone whose head is in it, the victim's soul is severed and sent to room 99; the neck and head remain fully intact because there is no blade. A person without a soul is immune to mind reading, mind control, and emotions; does not detect as living, dead, or undead; sits down and stares at a wall whenever left alone; says they do not feel mindless but feel empty; and never levels up again.
fields.title: Soul Severed by the Shroud Guillotine

fields.text: The spider crab's attack line is printed as 'Claw/claw 1d8/1d8+grab', so its second claw attack adds a grab effect.
fields.title: Spider Crab Grab

fields.text: If anyone climbs inside the Stone Egg, it zips back up and traps that person until death by suffocation. At death, the victim becomes a perpetually screaming head attached to a skeleton.
fields.title: Stone Egg Entrapment and Screaming-Head Transformation

fields.text: When a poison-filled coffer is opened, anyone in front must make a Dex save or be poisoned for 1d6 damage per round until a Con check succeeds. A hooked pole or opening from the side grants +4 to the Dex check. The gas then fills the room; characters who flee immediately are not poisoned, and the gas takes 10 minutes to settle.
fields.title: Sunken Gallery Poison Gas

fields.text: The first person to speak or pray to the statue has their left hand possessed. The hand is rigid and holds up a number of fingers equal to the number of ghouls remaining in the dungeon. Whenever a ghoul is encountered, the hand clenches with rage.
fields.title: Vandoh's Possessed Left Hand

fields.text: A Treasure called the Abacus of Vandoh is inside the opened Stone Egg; the source points to Appendix A for its full description.
fields.title: Abacus of Vandoh

fields.text: The crone's coffer contains a bottle of liquid boat; the source points to Appendix A for its full description.
fields.title: Bottle of Liquid Boat

fields.text: The crone's coffer contains a pouch holding 50 golden gorbels, valued at 500s.
fields.title: Pouch of 50 Golden Gorbels

fields.text: The crone's coffer contains the hand mirror of lies, a Treasure whose full description is in Appendix A.
fields.title: Hand Mirror of Lies

fields.text: The opened Stone Egg contains a severed head that never stops screaming. A person killed by entrapment in the egg also becomes a perpetually screaming head attached to a skeleton.
fields.title: Perpetually Screaming Head

fields.text: A cache of 600 silver shilavos is inside the opened Stone Egg.
fields.title: 600 Silver Shilavos

fields.text: A stone idol of Vandoh rises from the water in 41 SUNKEN SHRINE. The first person to speak or pray to it has their left hand possessed; the hand holds up a number of fingers equal to the ghouls remaining in the dungeon and clenches when a ghoul is encountered.
fields.title: Stone Idol of Vandoh

fields.text: The scroll clutched by the scribe statue reads: 'The sheep do not know the shepherd, but they follow nonetheless'.
fields.title: The Scribe's Scroll

contents: A stack of 12 planks partially obscures the doorway and appears to have boarded it up previously.
A huge shrouded object stands 9 feet tall.

discoverable.condition: Remove the shroud.
discoverable.information: Removing the shroud reveals a guillotine with no blade and a winch on its side.

discoverable.condition: Turn the winch.
discoverable.information: Turning the winch sounds and feels like a blade is being raised; after about 12 seconds the unseen mechanism falls with a heavy thunk.

fields.first_impression: A stack of 12 planks partly obscures the doorway. Beyond it stands a huge shrouded object about 9 feet tall.
hazards: The guillotine can sever a person's soul without physically injuring the head or neck.
hidden: The blade-less guillotine severs a victim's soul rather than the victim's head.
A severed soul is sent to room 99, which the source marks as not written yet.
fields.title: Shroud
triggers: Turning the winch starts a roughly 12-second cycle that ends with a heavy thunk.
A person whose head is in the guillotine when the cycle completes has their soul severed.

contents: A polished pinkish-brown stone egg about 3 feet tall, covered with grooves, whorls, and carved animals.
The carvings depict an ape, elephant, bat, chicken, snake, octopus, rat, pyorn (giant bird), horse, and toad.

discoverable.condition: Put an ear against the egg.
discoverable.information: Faint screaming can be heard from inside the Stone Egg.

discoverable.condition: Touch an animal carving.
discoverable.information: Each animal carving lights up when touched.

discoverable.condition: Experiment with the carvings or identify and touch all egg-laying animals at once.
discoverable.information: The egg unfolds like a flower when the chicken, snake, octopus, pyorn, and toad are touched simultaneously.

discoverable.condition: Accumulate incorrect inputs while testing the carvings.
discoverable.information: Every five incorrect animal touches makes the glow of a touched animal dimmer; after four failed attempts the egg becomes inert for 24 hours.

fields.first_impression: A ravenous ghoul shares the room with a polished pinkish-brown stone egg about 3 feet tall, covered in grooves, whorls, and carved animals.
hazards: The egg can trap and suffocate anyone who climbs inside.
hidden: The egg is Shawson the ghoul's prison.
Inside are 600 silver shilavos, the Abacus of Vandoh, a head that never stops screaming, and a headless skeleton.
Climbing inside causes the egg to zip shut and trap the entrant until suffocation; the corpse becomes a perpetually screaming head attached to a skeleton.
fields.title: Stone Egg
triggers: Touching all five egg-laying animal carvings simultaneously opens the egg.
Each five incorrect animal touches advances the failure track; after four failed attempts the egg is inert for 24 hours.
Opening the egg fills the air with screaming and provokes an Encounter check.
Climbing inside the opened egg causes it to zip shut.

contents: Thirty severed heads arranged as a barrier, alternating the directions they face; their yellow eyes look wet and alive.
Thirty hands dangling directly above the heads from a 30-foot rope held by two iron spikes between the north and south walls.
The rope and hands are entirely non-magical.

discoverable.condition: Move at least one head out of formation and observe the result.
discoverable.information: Moving any head out of the specific formation ends the fence's effects; returning the heads to formation restores them.

discoverable.condition: Remove and later restore the heads in their specific formation.
discoverable.information: The heads can be moved elsewhere and reassembled to recreate the effect.

fields.first_impression: A line of 30 rotten severed heads divides the east and west sides of the room. Above them, 30 hands hang from a rope stretched north to south.
hazards: The nearest targeted creature chatters its teeth uncontrollably.
Touching or crossing over the heads can kill the nearest living thing with no Save.
hidden: Touching the heads or passing over them kills the nearest living thing with no Save.
fields.title: Ghost Fence
triggers: The heads continuously stare at the nearest living or undead creature and make that target chatter its teeth.
Touching a head or passing over the formation triggers instant death for the nearest living thing.
Restoring the specific head formation reactivates the effects.

contents: Water 10 feet deep.

discoverable.condition: Look carefully into the water.
discoverable.information: Four stone pews, a rusted metal cage large enough to hold a person, a stone idol of Vandoh, and a quadrupedal statue lie beneath the water.

discoverable.condition: Examine the stone idol of Vandoh.
discoverable.information: The Vandoh statue is a polished marble muscular male in a toga, rendered in polygons with time-smoothed vertices; its platonic-solid head seems to have a different number of sides each time it is counted.

fields.first_impression: A shrine chamber lies under 10 feet of water, with several submerged stone and metal forms visible below the surface.
hazards: The submerged ancient apparatus attacks intruders with its slam and Ancient Tone.
hidden: The quadrupedal statue is an ancient apparatus of anguish made of pinkish-brown stone, grooves, and whorls.
Four feet of water above the apparatus's head protects it from falling bricks.
Two rounds after someone enters, the apparatus attacks and tries to exit the pit.
The first person to speak or pray to the Vandoh statue has their left hand possessed.
occupants: An ancient apparatus of anguish disguised externally as a quadrupedal statue.
fields.title: Sunken Shrine
triggers: Two rounds after anyone enters the room, the ancient apparatus attempts to attack and leave the pit.
The first person to speak or pray to the Vandoh statue triggers left-hand possession.

contents: Six huge statues, each with an integral stone coffer that cannot be removed.
A proud king holds his coffer overhead and gazes at the shepherd.
A weary knight watches the crone.
A smiling shepherd with a sheep under one arm watches the scribe.
A beggar extends a plate toward the crone.
A crone bows to the king and holds her coffer behind her back.
A scribe watches the crone while clutching a scroll to his chest.

discoverable.condition: Read the scroll clutched by the scribe statue.
discoverable.information: The scribe's scroll reads: 'The sheep do not know the shepherd, but they follow nonetheless'.

fields.first_impression: A 40-foot-tall gallery lies under 10 feet of water. Six huge statues loom from the pool, each holding a stone coffer.
hazards: Five coffers contain poison gas that expands to fill the room and takes 10 minutes to settle.
hidden: The king, knight, shepherd, beggar, and scribe coffers contain poisonous gas.
The crone's coffer contains the hand mirror of lies, a bottle of liquid boat, and a pouch of 50 golden gorbels worth 500s.
The room connects to 24 CRUSH HALLWAY and 25 TRICKY HALLWAY, but neither can be accessed unless its trap door is open.
resources: A pouch containing 50 golden gorbels, worth 500s.
fields.title: Sunken Gallery
triggers: Opening a poison-filled coffer exposes anyone in front of it to a Dex save against poisoning and then releases gas that fills the room.
Open trap doors permit access to 24 CRUSH HALLWAY and 25 TRICKY HALLWAY.

contents: Brown water 10 feet deep and much murkier than usual.

discoverable.condition: Notice the eyestalks or otherwise detect the hidden crab.
discoverable.information: A giant spider crab is watching from the water with its eyestalks near the surface.

fields.first_impression: A pool of unusually murky brown water lies 10 feet deep, with the floor above 40 feet above the water's surface.
hazards: The hidden giant undead spider crab lunges at anything that falls within reach.
hidden: A giant undead spider crab hides in the water.
The crab is all that remains of a high priestess of Vandoh.
The crab can reach 38 feet out of the water, two feet short of the floor above.
If a large object is dropped into the pool, the crab eventually uses it as a platform to escape.
occupants: A giant undead spider crab, formerly a high priestess of Vandoh.
fields.title: Spider Crab
triggers: The first time the crab notices that it has been noticed, it hides for a few seconds.
Anything dropped within its 38-foot reach causes it to lunge.
Dropping a large object such as a table or ballista into the pool eventually lets the crab stand on it and escape.

steps: Turn the winch; it sounds and feels as though a blade is being raised.
Continue for about 12 seconds.
The unseen 'blade' falls with a heavy thunk.
If a person's head is in the guillotine at that moment, apply the soul-severance effect; the head and neck remain intact.
fields.title: Operate the Shroud Guillotine
fields.trigger: Someone turns the winch on the blade-less guillotine.

steps: Touching any animal carving makes it light up.
Touch the five egg-laying animals—chicken, snake, octopus, pyorn, and toad—simultaneously.
On the correct simultaneous input, the egg unfolds like a flower.
Each set of five incorrect animal touches makes the glow of a touched animal dimmer.
After four failed attempts, the egg becomes inert for 24 hours before it can be tried again.
fields.title: Open the Stone Egg
fields.trigger: Someone interacts with the Stone Egg's animal carvings.

steps: Move at least one severed head out of its specific formation.
While the formation is broken, the fence's magical effects end.
Cross or move the heads as needed; the source suggests bowling with isopods as an easy way past.
If the heads are returned to their specific formation, the effects resume, even if the formation is rebuilt elsewhere.
fields.title: Disrupt the Ghost Fence
fields.trigger: The party needs to pass or neutralize the severed-head formation.

steps: Opening a poison-filled coffer forces anyone in front of it to make a Dex save or become poisoned for 1d6 damage per round until a Con check succeeds.
Opening with a hooked pole or from the side grants a +4 bonus to the Dex check.
After opening, the poison gas expands to fill the room.
Characters who flee immediately are not poisoned by the expanding gas.
The poison gas settles after 10 minutes.
fields.title: Handle a Sunken Gallery Coffer
fields.trigger: Someone opens one of the statues' stone coffers.

activation.condition: The guillotine cycle completes while someone has their head in it.

completion: The cycle ends when the guillotine falls with a heavy thunk.
outcomes: The soul is sent to room 99 while the head and neck remain intact.
The victim gains the source's soulless immunities, detection anomalies, and empty behavior.
fields.perceived: After about 12 seconds of winching, the guillotine falls with a heavy thunk. A victim's head and neck remain physically intact, but the victim thereafter seems empty.
stakes: The victim's soul can be separated from the body.
A soulless victim can never level up again.
fields.title: Soul-Severing Guillotine Cycle

activation.condition: The chicken, snake, octopus, pyorn, and toad carvings are touched simultaneously.

approaches: Identify and touch all five egg-laying animal carvings simultaneously.
completion: The egg unfolds like a flower after the correct simultaneous input.
outcomes: The egg opens and exposes 600 silver shilavos, the Abacus of Vandoh, a perpetually screaming head, and a headless skeleton.
A person who climbs inside is trapped until suffocation and transformed into a perpetually screaming head attached to a skeleton.
fields.perceived: The carved stone egg unfolds like a flower and the sound of screaming fills the air.

repeat.condition: Attempts can continue until it opens, but four failed attempts make it inert for 24 hours.

stakes: The screaming provokes an Encounter check.
Anyone who climbs inside can be sealed in and suffocated.
fields.title: The Stone Egg Opens

activation.condition: The 30 heads remain in their specific formation.

approaches: Move one or more heads out of formation.
Use isopods like bowling balls to get past the barrier; the source notes that many solutions exist.
completion: The party crosses while the formation is disrupted, or permanently leaves the heads out of formation.
outcomes: Breaking the formation ends the effects.
Restoring the formation reactivates the effects, even at a different location.
fields.perceived: The wet-eyed severed heads stare at the nearest creature and chatter their teeth; the watched creature's own teeth chatter uncontrollably.

repeat.condition: The effects resume whenever the formation is restored.

stakes: Touching the heads or passing over them kills the nearest living thing with no Save.
fields.title: Crossing the Ghost Fence

activation.condition: Two rounds after someone enters the Sunken Shrine, whether by falling or another route.

actor_reactions.reaction: On losing half its hit points, it begins bleeding and attempts to escape the room.

outcomes: If it escapes, it can be added to the wandering monster table.

participants.role: Attacks intruders and attempts to escape.

fields.perceived: Two rounds after someone enters, the submerged quadrupedal statue begins attacking and tries to climb out of the pit. At half hit points it starts bleeding despite its stone exterior.

possible_effects.description: An escaped ancient apparatus can be added to the wandering monster table.

stakes: Intruders face slam and Ancient Tone damage.
An escaping apparatus may become a wandering monster.
fields.title: Ancient Apparatus Awakening

activation.condition: The first person speaks or prays to the statue of Vandoh.

completion: Killing all ghouls triggers the character becoming Favored by Vandoh.
outcomes: The raised finger count equals the number of ghouls remaining in the dungeon.
The hand clenches with rage whenever a ghoul is encountered.
If all ghouls are killed, the character becomes Favored by Vandoh.
fields.perceived: The first speaker or supplicant's left hand becomes rigid and holds up a number of fingers. It clenches with rage whenever a ghoul is encountered.

possible_effects.description: If all ghouls are killed, the possessed character becomes Favored by Vandoh as described in Appendix D.

stakes: A character's left hand is possessed and rigid.
fields.title: Vandoh Possesses a Left Hand

activation.condition: Any of the five poison-filled coffers is opened.

approaches: Open the coffer with a hooked pole or from the side for a +4 bonus.
Flee immediately when the gas begins to fill the room.
completion: The gas settles 10 minutes after release.
outcomes: A failed Dex save poisons a character for 1d6 damage per round until a Con check succeeds.
Immediate flight avoids poisoning from the room-filling cloud.
The gas settles after 10 minutes.
fields.perceived: A poison-filled coffer releases gas from its front and the cloud expands through the gallery.

repeat.condition: The hazard can trigger from each poison-filled coffer.

stakes: Anyone in front of the coffer risks ongoing poison damage.
The expanding gas can poison characters who do not flee immediately.
fields.title: Poison Coffer Discharge

activation.condition: The giant undead spider crab remains hidden in the pool while creatures or objects are within the room.

actor_reactions.reaction: The first time it knows it has been seen, it hides for a few seconds.
It lunges at anything dropped within its reach.
It uses a large dropped object as a platform and eventually escapes.

approaches: Avoid dropping creatures or objects within the crab's reach.
Recognize that a large object in the pool will let the crab climb out.
completion: The crab escapes the pit after gaining a large object to stand on.
outcomes: The crab lunges at a falling target.
If a large object is dropped into the pool, the crab eventually escapes and is added to the wandering monster table.

participants.role: Watches from hiding, lunges at falling targets, and seeks a way out.

fields.perceived: Eyestalks watch from the murky water. When noticed, they dip away for a few seconds; anything falling close enough draws a sudden lunge from the pool.

possible_effects.description: After escaping, the spider crab is added to the wandering monster table.

repeat.condition: The crab can lunge whenever something drops within its 38-foot reach.

stakes: Anything falling within 38 feet of the surface can be attacked and grabbed.
A large dropped object can release the crab into the dungeon.
fields.title: Spider Crab in the Pool

behavior: It arrives at 44A in 5+1d4 minutes after the noisy breach if it is still alive and able to reach the location.

reactions.response: It converges on the location in 5+1d4 minutes if available.
reactions.stimulus: Noisy breaking of the wall at 44A.

fields.role: A surviving, reachable hostile party that is automatically attracted to the noisy breach at 44A.
fields.title: The Apparatus

behavior: They arrive at 44A in 5+1d4 minutes after the noisy breach, provided they are still alive and able to reach it.

reactions.response: All surviving, reachable ghouls converge on the location in 5+1d4 minutes.
reactions.stimulus: Noisy breaking of the wall at 44A.

fields.role: Any surviving ghouls able to reach 44A are an attracted hostile party when the wall is broken noisily.
fields.title: Available Ghouls

behavior: When someone enters the center of 44 CISTERN, it starts swimming toward them.
One round after beginning its approach, it urinates in anticipation and fills the air with an ammonia stink.
On the following round, it loses patience and begins swimming on the surface.
When noisy wall-breaking vibrations reach it, it arrives in 5+1d4 minutes and waits on the cistern bottom near the mouth of the underwater tunnel.
It rests in 8 PIT 2-in-6 of the time.
capabilities: Swims 10 feet per round.
Climbs the slick walls at 46 DAYLIGHT as fast as a human can.
hidden: The author recommends attacking it in 8 PIT when it is resting there, using fire and sharp things while it struggles to climb out.
The White Temple regards it as their godling.

reactions.response: The Lamb starts swimming toward that person.
reactions.stimulus: A person enters the central 50-foot-by-50-foot area of 44 CISTERN.

reactions.response: It urinates in anticipation, filling the air with the stink of ammonia.
reactions.stimulus: One round passes after the Lamb starts approaching.

reactions.response: It loses patience and swims on the surface.
reactions.stimulus: Another round passes after the ammonia warning.

reactions.response: It arrives in 5+1d4 minutes, then waits on the bottom near the underwater tunnel mouth.
reactions.stimulus: The wall at 44A is broken down noisily.

reactions.response: The attempt works automatically.
reactions.stimulus: The party fishes for it with the hook hand and acceptable bait for the first time.

fields.role: The creature that hunts entrants in the cistern and can be fought, lured, ensnared, or killed.
fields.title: The Lamb

behavior: It arrives at 44A in 5+1d4 minutes after the noisy breach if it is still alive and able to reach the location.

reactions.response: It converges on the location in 5+1d4 minutes if available.
reactions.stimulus: Noisy breaking of the wall at 44A.

fields.role: A surviving, reachable hostile party from above that is automatically attracted to the noisy breach at 44A.
fields.title: The Spider Crab

hidden: The Temple's expected response to the Lamb's body entering its drinking fountain is swift and forceful.

reactions.response: A swift and forceful response can be expected.
reactions.stimulus: The Lamb is dragged up by the noria and viscerally ejected into the White Temple's drinking fountain.

relationships.relationship: The White Temple regards the Lamb as its godling.

fields.role: The organization above the cistern that receives water from the noria and may retaliate if its godling is expelled into its drinking fountain.
fields.title: The White Temple

fields.text: One round after the Lamb begins swimming toward someone in the center of 44 CISTERN, it urinates in anticipation and fills the air with an ammonia stink. On the following round it loses patience and begins swimming on the surface.
fields.title: The Lamb's Ammonia Warning

fields.text: Breaking down the 44A wall is very noisy. Every available ghoul, the apparatus, and the spider crab that is still alive and able to reach the location arrives in 5+1d4 minutes. The Lamb also arrives in 5+1d4 minutes and waits on the bottom of 44 CISTERN near the underwater tunnel mouth.
fields.title: Noisy 44A Breach Attracts Threats

fields.text: With a couple of suitable tools, making an opening large enough for a man to squeeze through takes 6 minutes; making one wide enough to fit a table through takes 10 minutes.
fields.title: Timed Openings Through the 44A Wall

fields.text: No one answers when the party knocks at the locked steel door above 45 BARRELS.
fields.title: Knocking at the 45 BARRELS Door Gets No Answer

fields.text: One person can row the boat at 20 feet per round.
fields.title: Rowboat Movement at 45 BARRELS

fields.text: Reaching the stone stairs 20 feet overhead requires either a successful grappling-hook Attack roll against AC 15 or two Movement checks to climb the slick walls, one check for each 10 feet.
fields.title: Reaching the Stairs at 46 DAYLIGHT

fields.text: The statue of Vandoh in 46A can be toppled to block the trapdoor.
fields.title: Vandoh's Statue Can Block the Trapdoor

fields.text: A human swims 10 feet per round in the cistern. Every item carried reduces that speed by 1 foot per round, to a minimum of 5 feet per round.
fields.title: Carried Items Reduce Swim Speed

fields.text: Reaching freedom outside the dungeon counts as a Milestone.
fields.title: Escaping the Dungeon Is a Milestone

fields.text: When the party first tries to fish for the Lamb using the hook hand and acceptable bait, the attempt works automatically.
fields.title: First Lamb-Fishing Attempt Automatically Works

fields.text: The Lamb swims 10 feet per round and can climb the slick walls at 46 DAYLIGHT as fast as a human can.
fields.title: The Lamb's Movement Rates

fields.text: The Lamb is resting in 8 PIT 2-in-6 of the time, creating the recommended opportunity to attack it with fire and sharp things while it struggles to climb out.
fields.title: Chance the Lamb Is Resting in 8 PIT

fields.text: If the Lamb is ensnared in the noria, the waterwheel drags it along and crushes it against the slotted ceiling.
fields.title: The Noria Can Crush the Lamb

fields.text: The noria extends into the ceiling and carries water to the White Temple, but there is no space for a human to escape upward through it.
fields.title: The Noria Is Not a Human Escape Route

fields.text: A makeshift boat such as a table moves at 10 feet per round. Each paddle adds 1 foot per round up to 15 feet per round, and each person aboard beyond the second reduces its speed by 1 foot per round.
fields.title: Makeshift Table-Boat Speed Modifiers

fields.text: If the Lamb is viscerally ejected into the White Temple's drinking fountain, a swift and forceful response from the White Temple can be expected.
fields.title: White Temple Responds to Its Godling in the Fountain

fields.text: A grappling hook can reach the elevated stairs at 46 DAYLIGHT with a successful Attack roll against AC 15.
fields.title: Grappling Hook

fields.text: Harpoons are one of the suggested tools that can be combined with other tactics to kill the Lamb in the cistern.
fields.title: Harpoon

fields.text: The hook hand can be used with acceptable bait to fish for the Lamb; the first such attempt works automatically.
fields.title: Hook Hand

fields.text: Hooked nets are one of the suggested tools that can be combined with other tactics to kill the Lamb in the cistern.
fields.title: Hooked Net

fields.text: Burning oil is a suggested weapon against the Lamb in the cistern. The rowboat at 45 BARRELS contains 2 flasks of oil.
fields.title: Oil

fields.text: Ropes are one of the suggested tools that can be combined with other tactics to kill the Lamb in the cistern.
fields.title: Rope

fields.text: The rowboat at 45 BARRELS contains 2 flasks of oil. One person can row it at 20 feet per round.
fields.title: Rowboat

fields.text: The statue in 46A can be toppled to block the trapdoor.
fields.title: Statue of Vandoh

fields.text: A trumpet is present at the top of the White Temple tower in 46B TOWER.
fields.title: Trumpet

fields.text: There are 16 barrels containing water at 45 BARRELS, each stamped with the insignia of the White Temple.
fields.title: White Temple Water Barrels

fields.text: Investigating the newer wall reveals a loose brick. Removing it releases the smell of fresh air, and torchlight through a larger opening reveals a huge water-filled room receding into darkness with two water-stained pillars at the light's edge.
fields.title: Fresh Air and the Cistern Beyond 44A

fields.text: The locked steel door above the stairs leads to the White Temple's kitchen cellar, and no one answers when the party knocks.
fields.title: Destination Beyond the Door at 45 BARRELS

fields.text: The 60-foot noria carries water up to the White Temple and dumps it into a trough. It spills water constantly, and there is no human-sized space to escape into the temple through the wheel's ceiling opening.
fields.title: The Noria Feeds the White Temple

fields.text: The recommended tactic is to return to 8 PIT when the Lamb is resting there, which occurs 2-in-6 of the time, and attack it with fire and sharp things while it struggles to climb out.
fields.title: Preferred Opportunity to Kill the Lamb

fields.text: The Lamb is the White Temple's godling. If the noria viscerally ejects it into the Temple's drinking fountain, a swift and forceful response can be expected.
fields.title: White Temple Response to the Lamb's Death in the Noria

contents: Water 10 feet deep.
Sixteen huge water-stained pillars, each about 5 feet in diameter.
A 60-foot-tall noria of stout lumber near the south wall, extending into the ceiling and constantly spilling water.

discoverable.condition: Enter the central 50-foot-by-50-foot part of the room.
discoverable.information: A glow of sunlight is visible from the north.

discoverable.condition: Gain line of sight to 46 DAYLIGHT.
discoverable.information: A thick pillar of dusty light fills 46 DAYLIGHT.

discoverable.condition: Closely observe the noria and where it enters the ceiling.
discoverable.information: The noria carries water up to the White Temple and dumps it into a trough; there is no human-sized space to escape through the mechanism.

fields.first_impression: Ten-foot-deep water fills a vast chamber crowded by sixteen huge, water-stained pillars. A towering wooden waterwheel near the south wall splashes and creaks loudly.
hazards: Deep water slows swimmers who carry items.
The Lamb can pursue swimmers at 10 feet per round.
The moving noria can crush the Lamb against the slotted ceiling if it is ensnared.
hidden: As soon as someone enters the central 50-foot-by-50-foot area, the Lamb begins swimming toward them.
resources: A table can serve as a makeshift boat.
Planks or similar objects can serve as paddles.
The noria can be used as an environmental weapon against the Lamb.
Harpoons, hooked nets, ropes, and burning oil are suggested tools for fighting the Lamb here.
fields.title: 44 CISTERN
triggers: Entering the central 50-foot-by-50-foot area starts the Lamb's approach sequence.

contents: A more-modern brick wall on the west side.
Waist-high water.

discoverable.condition: Investigate the brick wall.
discoverable.information: The brick wall has a loose brick.

discoverable.condition: Remove the loose brick.
discoverable.information: Fresh air can be smelled through the wall.

discoverable.condition: Open the wall enough to shine torchlight through it.
discoverable.information: Beyond the wall is a huge room where water recedes into darkness; two huge water-stained pillars stand at the edge of torchlight.

fields.first_impression: Waist-high water covers the area. The western brick wall looks newer than the surrounding dungeon masonry, and faint splashing can be heard behind it.
hazards: Noisy demolition can draw several hostile parties and the Lamb.
hidden: Noisy wall-breaking attracts every available ghoul, the apparatus, and the spider crab that is still alive and able to reach this location; each arrives in 5+1d4 minutes.
The Lamb also hears the vibrations, arrives in 5+1d4 minutes, and waits on the bottom of 44 CISTERN near the mouth of the underwater tunnel.
If multiple attracted parties arrive at the same time, violence will probably break out atop the stairs.
resources: The loose brick provides a starting point for opening the wall.
A couple of suitable tools allow the opening to be enlarged on a fixed timetable.
fields.title: 44A WALL
triggers: Breaking down the wall is very noisy and initiates delayed arrivals from nearby threats.

contents: Sixteen barrels containing water, stamped with the insignia of the White Temple.
A rowboat containing 2 flasks of oil.
Stairs ascending to a locked steel door.
fields.first_impression: Sixteen water barrels stamped with the White Temple insignia stand here beside a rowboat. Stairs ascend to a locked steel door.
hidden: The locked steel door leads to the White Temple's kitchen cellar.
No one answers a knock at the locked steel door.
resources: The rowboat can be rowed by 1 person at 20 feet per round.
The rowboat contains 2 flasks of oil.
fields.title: 45 BARRELS

contents: Barely submerged rubble made from broken stairs.
Space for 1 man to stand.
Stone stairs 20 feet above the rubble.
fields.first_impression: Barely submerged rubble from broken stairs provides room for one person to stand beneath stone stairs suspended 20 feet overhead.
hazards: The surrounding walls are slick and require two Movement checks to climb, one for each 10 feet.
hidden: The elevated stairs rise 60 feet to a wooden trapdoor; the printed destination is internally inconsistent.
fields.title: 46 DAYLIGHT

contents: A statue of Vandoh.
Two locked steel doors.
Stairs going up 40 feet to 46B FREEDOM.
fields.first_impression: A circular room 30 feet in diameter contains a statue of Vandoh and two locked steel doors.
resources: The statue can be toppled to block the trapdoor.
fields.title: 46A STATUE

contents: A trumpet.
A 40-foot drop to the ground and freedom.
fields.first_impression: The top of one of the White Temple's towers holds a trumpet. The ground—and freedom—is 40 feet below.
resources: The trumpet can be taken from the tower top.
fields.title: 46B TOWER

Let the first attempt work automatically.

If the wall is broken down noisily, resolve the delayed hostile arrivals.

steps: Start with a speed of 10 feet per round.

For each person aboard beyond the second, reduce the speed by 1 foot per round.

fields.title: Reach the Elevated Stairs at 46 DAYLIGHT
